# ChoreoStudio

> Fee tracking and WhatsApp reminders for dance studio owners in India. ChoreoStudio shows which dancers have paid, who is due and who is overdue, and opens a WhatsApp reminder with each dancer's amount filled in. The studio owner presses Send. First month free, no card needed.

## Facts
- Product: ChoreoStudio, a web app for owner-run dance studios. Website: https://choreostudio.live
- Who it is for: dance studio owners. Dancers are adults and do not need an app or an account.
- What it does: keeps fees, attendance and batches in one place; records payments by cash, UPI, bank transfer or other, with an optional reference; shows what is still owed after part payments; opens a WhatsApp reminder for each unpaid dancer.
- What it does not do: it does not send messages automatically (automated WhatsApp messages are planned for Studio+ and are labelled "coming soon"), and it never holds or processes dancers' money. Dancers pay the studio directly.
- Pricing (INR, per month, as of October 2026): first month free with every feature and no card. Regular Rs 249 for up to 50 dancers. Studio+ Rs 479 for more than 50 dancers. Cancel any time.
- Data: records are stored in Mumbai. Only the studio can see them. A dancer sees only their own fees, through a private link the studio sends.
- Contact: support@choreostudio.live
